system.description:
• Underground fighting rings in Mournas — illegal, brutal, and well-attended. No forms, no philosophy, just what works when a crowd is watching and money is on the line. Fighters here learn fast or they don't get up.
  • Opening Blow: Once per round, on the initial grab of a grapple or overbearing attempt, deal primary unarmed damage on success in addition to gaining control. Holding a grapple does not continue to deal damage automatically.
  • Ring Reader: Advantage on Intimidation checks before or during combat, and on checks to read an opponent's fighting style in the first round.
